question: Can a useful conditional predictor and finite empirical generator be fitted from public-native benchmark samples when fitting receives no source equations, exact population support bounds, latent state, population coordinates, generator implementation, or evaluation truth?
claim_scope: the named PUBLIC_NATIVE benchmark and DatasetSpec
the frozen participant-visible fields and ordinary units
the independent realizations, fitted methods, and evaluation criteria in this protocol
hypotheses: H1: At least one conditional learner has lower independent-test error than the plan-by-horizon empirical mean baseline; otherwise predictive utility is inconclusive or unsupported for these samples.

H2: Sequence-aware nonlinear Ridge may improve or worsen conditional prediction relative to summary Ridge; the paired entity interval, not a universal ranking, determines whether the finite-sample contrast is resolved.
H3: Empirical finite-support resampling reproduces donor rows exactly while remaining limited by its finite observed record support.
H4: Independent population and observation draws expose finite-sample coverage and measurement-noise sensitivity that cannot be inferred from training extrema alone.

H5: Matched supported plan contrasts may differ across fitted surrogates even when their observational predictive performance is similar; such agreement or disagreement does not identify the source mechanism.

inputs.row_id: opaque synthetic alignment key; excluded from features
inputs.entity_id: opaque synthetic alignment key; excluded from features

lifts.history_schedule: ordered inclusive-day segments with dimensionless dose and intensity

history_schedule_values.segment_coverage: inclusive, contiguous day segments from 0 through 223

participant_schema.feature_rule: Use only declared participant-visible numeric fields and plan/horizon category values. Exclude row_id and entity_id.

SURROGATE_LEARNER.execution: separate isolated Python subprocess; staged learner source; JSON request on stdin and result on stdout
allowed: fitting rows and their target labels
development rows and their target labels
the frozen NumPy-only model budgets and seeds
blocked: all M2 world source modules and exact support declarations
all test target or latent truth fields
filesystem, network, subprocess, and repository imports

access: frozen public-native generator and benchmark contracts
private-to-the-run matched-entity grouping for supported plan contrasts
EVALUATION_AUTHORITY.flow_rule: No privileged source, truth, score, support-bound, or matched-group information is serialized into learner input or used by learner feature construction, tuning, or model selection.

splits.unit: one entity, one declared plan, one horizon, all three lifts
splits.entity_disjointness: Fitting, development, test A, test B, and matched evaluation populations are disjoint. Noise replicate A is paired to test A only in authority-side metadata.

empirical_finite_support_resampler_v1.prediction: mean target by declared plan and horizon, without history conditioning
empirical_finite_support_resampler_v1.generation: 384 complete participant-visible input records sampled with replacement within plan-by-horizon strata

summary_ridge_v1.features: per lift/channel latest, mean, and linear trend; per lift/schedule-channel mean, standard deviation, latest value, and trend; plan and horizon one-hot
summary_ridge_v1.fit: closed-form multi-output Ridge on fitting rows only; standardize using fitting rows
summary_ridge_v1.development_budget: 4 alpha values: [0.1, 1, 10, 100]; select by mean target-standardized development MSE

sequence_rff_ridge_v1.features: ordered 32-step observations and historical schedule, plus plan and horizon one-hot; generic random Fourier features; no equation-derived features
sequence_rff_ridge_v1.fit: 128 random Fourier features, seed 290190; closed-form Ridge on fitting rows only; standardize using fitting rows
sequence_rff_ridge_v1.development_budget: 9 fixed configurations from gamma [0.01, 0.05, 0.2] by alpha [0.1, 1, 10]; select by mean target-standardized development MSE
sequence_rff_ridge_v1.justification: Ordered public histories support a sequence-aware check; random Fourier features permit generic nonlinear interactions without encoding the source law.

methods.conditional_sampling: not implemented; the two fitted conditional models emit means only

metrics: field-wise 1-Wasserstein distance normalized by fitting-sample scale, separately by lift and observation channel
absolute correlation-matrix discrepancy for frozen visible summaries
declared plan, horizon, and history-template frequency discrepancies

conditional_response_fidelity.intervention: all four declared plans, matched within authority-generated entity, historical schedule, history/noise, and horizon
conditional_response_fidelity.estimand: predicted minus true within-entity change in each capacity-change target relative to the continue plan

metrics: visible test rows outside observed fitting extrema
nearest fitting-row distance on standardized visible features
empirical generated-record donor fraction and unique donor count
finite_sample_and_memorization.interpretation: Observed extrema and nearest-neighbor distances are finite-sample diagnostics, not estimates of true population bounds.

structural_nonidentification.similarity_rule: Report whether paired 95% entity-bootstrap predictive-error contrasts are resolved; also report prediction and matched-response disagreements.
structural_nonidentification.claim_rule: No finite predictive or distributional match establishes structural equivalence or source-system identification.

uncertainty.resampling_unit: entity; matched plan/horizon rows and paired noise observations remain clustered within authority entity
uncertainty.paired_contrasts: resample paired entities with the frozen bootstrap seed and retain all rows for every selected entity
uncertainty.degenerate_cells: emit explicit INCONCLUSIVE status and denominator; never drop entities silently

support_and_failure_rules.admissible_region: Only the four declared plan values above, four historical templates per lift, valid observation dates, and learner-visible schema
support_and_failure_rules.unsupported_extrapolation: Inputs outside the declared plan/schema region are UNSUPPORTED_BY_PROTOCOL and are not scored; no source-support extrapolation is tested.
support_and_failure_rules.source_support: Never inferred from observed extrema. Evaluation reports sample coverage only and keeps exact source support authority-side.
support_and_failure_rules.firewall_failure: Fail the complete run before scoring.
support_and_failure_rules.method_failure: Retain a method-specific failure row and continue other frozen methods.
support_and_failure_rules.inconclusive: Intervals spanning zero or insufficient support remain inconclusive; no post-outcome budget or method changes.

rights.training_and_evaluation_rows: New public synthetic artifacts generated from independently authored public-native source; MIT/CC-BY-4.0 attribution as scoped by each artifact
